aggregate.maintenance_expectation: Network collection is online. Current-storage cold backup, publication and final integrity are capped at 240 seconds, with at most 120 seconds recovery. Representative native timing must pass before activation; measure actual stop-to-ready separately from total runtime. Reporting and delivery follow restoration.

controls.redirect_policy: Initial 3xx counts; no redirect follow-up. Scope change requires review.
controls.locks: Shared maintenance gate spans online collection and offline publication. Runtime keeps DB ownership online; offline lifetime ownership, verified current-storage backup and original observation provenance cover publication. Worker timeouts reap the process group.
controls.failure_isolation: A source timeout/failure does not consume sibling allowance. SIGTERM/global storage failure cancels collection and restores beta. No absence closure on failed/partial collections.
controls.publication: Strict bound staged observations in existing authoritative journal; current-data publication through existing tracking/acceptance/rollup; zero HTTP; original timestamps, exclusive publication claim, preserved candidate history.

alert.remaining: Reviewed Resend HTTPS adapter and domain-restricted sending key through LoadCredential. Sender ops.wahojobs.com and recipient danilo@wahojobs.com are selected; activation receipt records verified DNS, real delivery and owner receipt. Examples remain disabled.
